paper_title: The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful   Communication Datasets
caption: Single vs. multiple platforms as data sources over time. While most of the datasets are collected from a single source, around 2018 researchers are increasingly collecting data from multiple sources (i.e., two or more).

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the number of datasets over a series of years, categorized by the number of data sources. The horizontal axis contains the categories of years, ranging from 2012 to 2022, labeled as "Year," while the vertical axis represents the "Number of datasets," following a linear scale with values ranging from 0 to 120 at intervals of 20. The bars are grouped by year, with each group displaying two bars differentiated by color: blue for datasets with 1 source and orange for datasets with 2 or more sources. In 2012, both bars are relatively short, indicating minimal datasets, while 2021 features the tallest blue bar, reaching over 100 datasets, and a significant orange bar, indicating around 70 datasets. The stacking of bars in 2020 and 2021 shows a notable increase in dataset numbers. The dataset count generally increases over time, with the blue bars consistently taller than the orange ones until 2021, where both show substantial values. All bars are arranged chronologically by year, and none are visually emphasized beyond the color distinction. A legend is located in the top left of the plot to match different bar colors to their corresponding category labels.
